Driver requires successful original private claim before the optional journey. It uses actual UI reviews and checks the real encrypted workflow in-page before each confirmation: content/budget/Bok scope, original nonce/request/target/draft and authorization hash. Only closed booleans escape until post publication.

Existing wallet sign/send/relay denial and Node-owned late-attempt counters remain. Success requires exactly two additional observed node sends and zero proof traffic; original120s owner remains and partial failure retains original profile/workflow rather than retrying.

Actual SDK decoder then binds constructor/class, canonical receipt/effect/events and rechecks all event block anchors.

Terminal accounting requires exact request/budget, zero available/reserved and positive charge plus refund conserving budget. This proves chain event/accounting linkage only; independent original provider billing attestation is explicitly false.
